message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_13359",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":100,"var":"data","code":"idn2_to_ascii_4i((uint32_t *) data, size / 4, out2, 0)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input bytes interpreted as 13 uint32_t code points, passed directly to idn2_to_ascii_4i"},
   {"step":2,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_4i2",
    "line":382,"var":"input_u8","code":"input_u8 = u32_to_u8 (input_u32, inlen + 1, NULL, &length)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"The 13 uint32 code points (including U+12020, U+3220, U+2020) are converted to a UTF-8 string"},
   {"step":3,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_4i2",
    "line":385,"var":"output_u8","code":"rc = idn2_lookup_u8 (input_u8, &output_u8, flags)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"UTF-8 domain string is looked up with NONTRANSITIONAL flag (set by set_default_flags)"},
   {"step":4,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_lookup_u8",
    "line":265,"var":"out","code":"rc = _tr46 (src, &out, flags)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"TR46 mapping is applied to the UTF-8 domain; characters like U+3220 are expanded to multiple code points"},
   {"step":5,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46",
    "line":148,"var":"len2","code":"len2 += map.nmappings",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"The length check len2 >= IDN2_DOMAIN_MAX_LENGTH (255) validates code point count but not the resulting UTF-8 byte length; mapped characters expand in UTF-8 encoding and can exceed the fixed-size _mapped buffer"},
   {"step":6,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_lookup_u8",
    "line":275,"var":"_mapped","code":"memcpy (_mapped, out, outlen + 1)",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Heap-buffer-overflow: the TR46 mapped output exceeds the stack buffer _mapped[IDN2_DOMAIN_MAX_LENGTH+1] (256 bytes) because multi-byte UTF-8 characters expand beyond the code-point-based length limit"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
     "line":100,"operands":["(uint32_t *) data","size / 4"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46",
     "line":148,"operands":["len2","IDN2_DOMAIN_MAX_LENGTH"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"len2","right":"IDN2_DOMAIN_MAX_LENGTH"}},
   "sink":{"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_lookup_u8",
     "line":275,"operands":["outlen + 1","sizeof(_mapped)"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"outlen + 1","right":"sizeof(_mapped)"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":100,"operands":["data"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46",
       "line":148,"operands":["domain_u32"]},
      "type":"data","via":["input_u32","input_u8","src"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"domain_u32[it]","right":"input code points"}},
     {"from":{"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46",
       "line":148,"operands":["len2"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_lookup_u8",
       "line":275,"operands":["outlen"]},
      "type":"data","via":["out","u32_to_u8"],
      "relation":{"op":"gt","left":"outlen","right":"len2"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
